title: TargetDesign-workbench
description:
TargetDesign-workbench is a motif-first toolkit for CRISPR guide design. Motif patterns are defined first, candidate regions are extracted, exact, indexed, BLAST-based and model-based off-target searches are run, and candidates are scored, filtered, ranked and exported. The software provides a desktop workbench, a local web interface and command-line tools backed by the same analysis modules.

English help is provided under docs/help_en/; the Chinese overview is in README.zh-CN.md and reference documentation is under docs/.
